cs.t: My $350 sony headphones regularly have trouble connecting to my macbook.  While speaking, about once every 10 hours of use, I sound like a robot and have to power cycle them to make the mic work correctly. If they're connected to my android phone while also connected to any other device (dual connection is a feature they tout), they play a tick sound every minute like a terrible metronome. I'm incredibly sympathetic to Apple deciding everything about bluetooth is hot garbage and building an alternative for audio.
cs.th: Bluetooth remains an 'unusually painful' technology after two decades
